name: NVIDIA Corporation
description: NVIDIA Corporation is a global leader in accelerated computing. It specializes in the design of Graphics Processing Units (GPUs) for gaming and professional markets, as well as System on a Chip (SoC) units for the mobile computing and automotive market.
businessModel: NVIDIA generates revenue primarily through the sale of high-performance GPUs and AI networking solutions. Its data center segment, driven by AI training and inference, is its largest revenue contributor.
geopoliticalSummary: NVIDIA faces significant geopolitical exposure due to its heavy reliance on TSMC in Taiwan for manufacturing and its exposure to U.S. export controls on high-performance chips to China.

revenueByGeography.note: Exact segment name from filing: 'United States'
Impacted by U.S. export control requirements.

keySuppliers.name: TSMC
keySuppliers.strategicNote: Sole manufacturer of advanced GPUs. Verbatim from 10-K: 'We utilize a single foundry, TSMC, for the manufacturing of all our semiconductor wafers for our GPU and Tegra products.'

keyCustomers.name: Microsoft
keyCustomers.strategicNote: Major hyperscale customer for AI infrastructure.

commodityDependencies.note: CoWoS advanced packaging is sole-sourced from TSMC Taiwan.

regionalExposures.note: Subject to US export controls on high-end GPUs. Verbatim from 10-K: 'The U.S. government announced new and updated licensing requirements for exports to China... of our A100 and H100 integrated circuits.'
Manufacturing concentration in Taiwan. Verbatim from 10-K: 'Geopolitical tensions between China and Taiwan... could cause material adverse impacts to our business.'

infrastructureDependencies.name: Trans-Pacific (North) Shipping Route
infrastructureDependencies.note: Logistics from Taiwan to global data centers.

sources.name: NVIDIA 10-K FY2024
sources.verbatimQuote: The U.S. government announced new and updated licensing requirements for exports to China and Russia.

name: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company Limited
description: TSMC is the world's largest dedicated independent semiconductor foundry. It manufactures chips for global technology leaders using the most advanced process technologies.
businessModel: TSMC operates as a pure-play foundry, earning revenue by manufacturing semiconductor wafers for customers based on their proprietary designs.
geopoliticalSummary: TSMC is at the heart of global geopolitical competition due to its dominance in advanced chipmaking. It faces extreme exposure to cross-strait tensions and U.S.-China trade conflicts.

revenueByGeography.note: Driven by major customers like Apple and NVIDIA.
Significant presence in the regional tech ecosystem.

keySuppliers.name: ASML
keySuppliers.strategicNote: Sole provider of EUV lithography systems. Verbatim from 20-F: 'We rely on a limited number of suppliers for critical equipment... such as EUV scanners from ASML.'

keyCustomers.name: Apple
keyCustomers.strategicNote: Largest customer, utilizing most advanced nodes.

commodityDependencies.note: Entirely dependent on ASML for advanced node capability.

regionalExposures.note: Verbatim from 20-F: 'Most of our operations, including our manufacturing facilities, are located in Taiwan... cross-strait tensions could adversely affect our business.'

infrastructureDependencies.name: Taiwan Power Grid
infrastructureDependencies.note: Highly energy-intensive operations dependent on stable power in Taiwan.

sources.name: TSMC 20-F FY2024
sources.verbatimQuote: Any military conflict or significant increase in tensions between China and Taiwan could materially and adversely affect our business.

name: ASML Holding N.V.
description: ASML is the world's leading supplier to the semiconductor industry, providing chipmakers with hardware, software, and services to mass produce patterns on silicon through lithography.
businessModel: ASML generates revenue by selling advanced lithography systems (EUV and DUV) and providing maintenance and support services to semiconductor manufacturers.
geopoliticalSummary: ASML is a critical chokepoint in the global AI supply chain as the sole provider of EUV machines. It is heavily impacted by U.S.-driven export controls on sales and service to China.

revenueByGeography.note: Record sales driven by backlog and demand for mature-node equipment.
Driven by DRAM and logic customers.
Historically the largest market; saw a decline in 2024.

keySuppliers.name: Carl Zeiss SMT
keySuppliers.strategicNote: Sole provider of optical columns for EUV systems. Verbatim from 20-F: 'Carl Zeiss SMT is our sole supplier of the optical columns for our systems.'

keyCustomers.name: TSMC
keyCustomers.strategicNote: Primary customer for EUV and High-NA EUV systems.

commodityDependencies.note: Sole-source dependency on Carl Zeiss SMT.

regionalExposures.note: Verbatim from 20-F: 'We are subject to export control regulations... and we are currently prohibited from shipping EUV systems to China.'

infrastructureDependencies.name: Specialized Air Freight
infrastructureDependencies.note: Requires specialized transport for sensitive 200-ton machines.

sources.name: ASML 20-F FY2024
sources.verbatimQuote: The international trade environment and geopolitical tensions are a significant risk to our business.

name: Advanced Micro Devices, Inc.
description: AMD is a global semiconductor company that designs microprocessors and graphics processors for the computer and consumer electronics industries.
businessModel: AMD generates revenue by designing and selling CPUs and GPUs for data centers, PCs, and gaming consoles. It is a key competitor to NVIDIA in the AI accelerator market.
geopoliticalSummary: AMD is a fabless company with critical dependency on TSMC in Taiwan. It faces significant headwinds from U.S. export controls on its advanced AI accelerators (Instinct series) to China.

revenueByGeography.note: Subject to significant export control restrictions.

keySuppliers.name: TSMC
keySuppliers.strategicNote: Sole source for all products at 7nm and smaller. Verbatim from 10-K: 'We rely on TSMC to manufacture all of our microprocessor and GPU products... at 7nm and smaller process nodes.'

keyCustomers.name: Meta Platforms
keyCustomers.strategicNote: Major customer for EPYC CPUs and Instinct GPUs.

commodityDependencies.note: Dependency on Taiwan for leading-edge node production.

regionalExposures.note: Verbatim from 10-K: 'Geopolitical tensions between China and Taiwan... could materially and adversely affect our business.'

infrastructureDependencies.name: Trans-Pacific (North) Shipping Route
infrastructureDependencies.note: Supply chain from Taiwan to US and global assembly sites.

sources.name: AMD 10-K FY2024
sources.verbatimQuote: Geopolitical changes between China and Taiwan could disrupt our operations.

name: Applied Materials, Inc.
description: Applied Materials, Inc. provides manufacturing equipment, services, and software to the semiconductor, display, and related industries.
businessModel: AMAT earns revenue by selling complex manufacturing tools for wafer fabrication and providing lifecycle services and spare parts to chipmakers.
geopoliticalSummary: AMAT is highly exposed to the Chinese market (37% of revenue) and faces significant risks from tightening U.S. export controls on equipment and services to China.

revenueByGeography.note: Largest and most critical market; subject to severe export control risks.
Key customer base in memory and logic.
Primary market for leading-edge foundry tools.
Growth driven by domestic manufacturing expansion.
